title: Floor Plan Terms for Default, Referral and Reinstatement
content:
Three floor plan values of the Apartment Home Lease apply once rent has gone unpaid long enough for a delinquency notice: the past-due rent needed before an expired notice may be referred to eviction counsel, whether a partial payment is accepted after a notice has been served, and whether a tenancy may be reinstated after an eviction case is filed.

| Floor plan | Minimum past-due rent for referral (multiple of monthly rent) | Partial payment accepted after a notice is served | Reinstatement allowed after filing |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 1.00 | No | Yes |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 1.00 | No | Yes |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 1.00 | No | Yes |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 1.00 | No | Yes |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 1.00 | No | Yes |
| Penthouse Residence | 1.00 | No | Yes |

- **Minimum past-due rent for referral** — the past-due rent, as a multiple of monthly rent, at or above which an expired delinquency notice may be referred to eviction counsel: one full month of rent on every floor plan.
- **Partial payment after notice** — whether a payment smaller than the full amount demanded is accepted once a delinquency notice has been served: not accepted on any floor plan.
- **Reinstatement after filing** — whether a tenancy may be reinstated after an eviction case is filed: allowed on every floor plan.

**Hypothetical:** on an example monthly rent of $1,650.00, the referral minimum of 1.00 corresponds to $1,650.00 of past-due rent. The rent is an example input.
